gizmo.title: Tsvaga nzvimbo
gizmo.description: Vadzidzi vanowana nzvimbo dzakarurama pamufananidzo nekudzvanya, kubaya kana kufambisa crosshair yekeyboard. Chinoenderana chine mamakisi chemepu yemufananidzo.

configure.title: Mamwe mavara
configure.description: Inotsanangura mufananidzo kuvanhu vasingagoni kuuona. Haimboratidzwi semusoro.

configure.title: Mhinduro
configure.description: Mhinduro imwe neimwe ioval ine zita pamufananidzo. Nzvimbo nesaizi zvikamu muzana zvemufananidzo, zvichiyerwa kubva pakona yawo yepamusoro kuruboshwe. Paunogadzirisa, mhinduro yese inotenderedzwa pamufananidzo.

advanced.title: Kuedza
advanced.description: Kangani mudzidzi anogona kuedza. 0 zvinoreva kusingaperi.

advanced.title: Kukanganisa kunobvumirwa
advanced.description: Kukanganisa kungani kunopedza kuedza. 0 zvinoreva kusingaperi, uye vadzidzi vanowana bhatani rePedza.

advanced.title: Inopetwa
advanced.description: Ratidza mubvunzo uyu semutsara unovhurika nekuvhara. Kuvhura imwe kunovhara mimwe mibvunzo inopetwa iri padhuze nayo.

advanced.title: Tanga yakapetwa
advanced.description: Kana ichipetwa, tanga semutsara wakavharwa unoratidza mubvunzo nemamiriro awo chete.

advanced.title: Fomati yemamakisi
advanced.description: OER Schema: fomati yemamakisi eongororo iyi (semuenzaniso mapoinzi, tsamba, muzana, kupedza).

advanced.title: Chinangwa chekudzidza
advanced.description: OER Schema: chinangwa chekudzidza chakabatanidzwa neongororo iyi.

developer.title: Zita rekuyedzwa
developer.description: Zita rekuyedzwa rinopihwa kuti rishandiswe munzvimbo dzinotungamirwa nexAPI pakuziva chinhu ichi

developer.title: Kosi
developer.description: OER Schema: kosi iyo ongororo iyi yakagadzirirwa.
